propositions: Provider-prefixed model_ref strings (anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6, openai:gpt-5.4) cause genai_prices.calc_price to raise LookupError, which is silently caught and converted to unpriced rows with no warning
Bedrock-prefixed rows price successfully while Anthropic and OpenAI rows both silently drop to unpriced, creating asymmetric cost comparison bias where only Bedrock appears measured
The LookupError catch at usage_log.py:429 masks the underlying id format mismatch, making genuinely unpriced models indistinguishable from mis-formatted qualified ids
The fix must use registry membership via config.split_provider_qualifier to translate provider-qualified ids into resolvable bare model refs, not prefix-sniffing or blind split operations
Unpriced rows must remain tolerated to preserve pricing best-effort policy, but must be made distinguishable and visible in summarize output to expose previously silent drops
